result.description:
Who We Are

Kidz Galore is a respected, local provider of childcare services, providing early childhood education for children aged 0-5 years. Established in 1995, Kidz Galore is owned by three families. As a family business, Kidz Galore retains personal touch, which we feel is most important when dealing with life’s most precious gift. Several positions available located on multiple centres across Perth region.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for passionate Early Childhood Teachers who promote children's education through their interests and plan learning opportunities therefrom. You will foster children's curiosity and create opportunities for children to grow and explore in small groups.

The ideal candidate will value the wonder of early learning within our upcycled learning environments and guide staff in providing a fun, safe, high-quality service that aligns with the National Quality Standards and is true to Kidz Galore’s reputation.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide a safe and stimulating environment that meets the social, cultural, emotional, educational and physical needs of children and promotes their agency, choices, and influence.
* Deliver effective and valuable documentation of children’s learning in accordance with the centre philosophy and the Learning Outcomes of the EYLF
* Model and support other educators to utilise a variety of teaching strategies including intentional teaching and reflective practice in daily work
* Develop and maintain respectful, supportive, collaborative and responsive relationships with children
* Facilitate and develop programs to encourage growth in communication and language skills including organizing various group-based activities.
* Liaise with families and discuss of each child’s development with parents and implementation of family support programs for early childhood development
* Attend professional development opportunities and network meeting as appropriate or as directed by director/coordinator
* Stay informed about the current trends in policy changes within the sector and assist in developing, implementing and reviewing policies and procedures in accordance with the NQS and National Law, considering confidentiality.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the service through reflective practice and the development and maintenance of the service quality improvement plan, as directed by the director/coordinator and educational leader.
* Supervise student teachers on placement if required.

Skills & Qualifications

* Relevant bachelor's degree or higher qualification (or equivalent)
* At least 12 months experience in early childhood teaching role (preferred)
* Current WA Working With Children Check (or ability to obtain)
* Current First Aid Certificate, Anaphylaxis and Asthma Management Certificate. or willingness to obtain
* Medically fit to work within a childcare environment
* Demonstrate a commitment to excellence and professional quality care
* A great work ethic and communication skills with the ability to be proactive and take initiative.
* We offer competitive remuneration based on skills and experience (salary range: $75,000 - $85,000 per annum)

If you are a motivated and qualified Early Childhood Teacher looking to join a reputable childcare and early education company, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now with your resume and relevant certifications.

Who we are

Johnson Winter Slattery is a full service commercial firm with specialist expertise in all facets of commercial activity, covering the spectrum of transactional needs, advisory and compliance as well as dispute resolution.

Our lawyers and practice groups are ranked as leading, by Chambers Asia-Pacific, Asia Pacific Legal 500, Best Lawyers and Doyle’s Guide. We enjoy a reputation as a leading independent Australian firm focused on complex transactions and disputes.

We have over 500 professionals and support staff working in our Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth, Canberra and Brisbane offices.


About the Team

Our national IT support team provide timely and effective IT support to all JWS staff nationally. As the firm continues to grow and implement new technology to support the growth, our IT team manage all aspects of deployment to ensure a smooth and efficient user experience.
 

About the Role

An opportunity for an IT Support Officer exists to join our Sydney office on a full time basis. You will support the IT team to provide remote 1st level IT support to all members of the firm. In addition, you will provide 2nd level desktop support to members of our Sydney office.

This role will see you draw on your strong communication and customer service skills to troubleshoot or escalate day to day IT issues across the firm.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Hardware and software support, equipment set ups, and meeting room conference support
- ITIL service management process
- Service desk ticketing system call logging, and updating in accordance with SLA's
- Assist with IT changes and upgrades as directed

Our Sydney office is a welcoming and collaborative office that fosters a supportive and high-performing environment. This is an exciting opportunity to join a cohesive IT Support team.
 

About You

You obviously have plenty of technical aptitude and previous relevant experience, but there is much more to you. You:

- have a minimum of 1 yr previous experience with Microsoft OS and Office application support;
- operational knowledge of Microsoft Desktop technologies;
- familiarity with computer hardware and network technologies;
- excellent skills in critical thinking, problem solving, troubleshooting and analysis;
- work well under pressure, meet your deadlines and excel working in a team;
- have strong communication and stakeholder management skills and you aren't afraid to use them, internally and externally; and
- take a collaborative, positive and energetic approach to everything you do
- law firm or professional services experience is ideal
 

Working at JWS

We value collaboration and our teams work together to achieve shared outcomes. We care about the wellbeing of our people and will invest time in understanding your objectives so we can support you throughout your career. We believe it’s this focus on our people that has seen our firm grow rapidly to become one of Australia’s leading independent law firms.

We pride ourselves on being down-to-earth, approachable, and always high-performing. We have
worked hard to create a culture where people look out for each other.

We offer:

- A collegiate environment with a collaborative culture across offices and practice groups
- High-quality work with committed mentors supporting your career development
- Comprehensive benefits including competitive remuneration, flexible working, and extensive social and wellbeing initiatives
- Opportunities for professional growth through structured learning and development programs, and employee recognition initiatives
- Annual base salary of $79,900 plus superannuation

If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity to take your career to the next level, then we would love to hear from you.

result.description:
Travel Agency Manager

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

As a Travel Agency Manager, your primary focus will be to oversee the operations of our travel agency, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maximising sales performance. You will lead a team of Travel Sales Consultants, motivating and guiding them to achieve sales targets and provide outstanding customer experiences. A crucial part of your role will be the recruitment, training, and development of staff, ensuring they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles.

Key Responsibilities:
- Leading and overseeing the overall operations and strategic direction of the travel agency.
- Developing and implementing business plans and strategies to achieve company objectives and targets.
- Managing financial aspects, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.
- Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, such as travel suppliers, partners, and clients.
- Analysing market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats in the industry.
- Recruiting, training, and mentoring staff members to ensure a high level of professionalism and service quality.
- Setting performance goals and KPIs for the team, monitoring progress, and providing guidance as needed.
- Driving sales and revenue growth through effective marketing, pricing strategies, and product offerings.
- Developing and maintaining operational policies, procedures, and standards to ensure efficiency and compliance.
- Handling escalated customer issues and complaints, seeking resolution, and maintaining customer satisfaction.
- Negotiating contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favourable terms and conditions.
- Staying updated on industry regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
- Utilising technology tools and systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
- Analysing data and metrics to evaluate performance, identify areas for improvement, and make informed decisions.
- Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote services.
- Monitoring and managing risk factors, such as safety, security, and legal liabilities, to protect the company’s interests.
- Fostering a positive work culture and environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and superannuation package.
- Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
- Travel incentives and familiarisation trips.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.
- A supportive and dynamic work environment.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience as a travel agency manager or Diploma or Higher plus 1 year of experience.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
- Experience in staff recruitment, training, and development.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.

Australian Citizens & Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.

Join the Happy Travels team and lead the way in creating unforgettable experiences for travellers and adventurers. Apply now to become our Travel Agency Manager and embark on a rewarding career journey!

We are looking for an experienced and strategic ICT Manager to lead the planning, development, and day-to-day management of our organisation's information and communication technology systems. This role is central to ensuring our technology infrastructure supports business objectives effectively and securely. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical knowledge, sound leadership capability, and the ability to translate complex ICT requirements into practical solutions. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to drive digital initiatives and maintain a reliable, secure, and efficient ICT environment.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to meet current and future business requirements
Formulate, implement, and continuously review ICT strategies, policies, and operational plans aligned with broader organisational goals
Direct the evaluation, procurement, and installation of ICT hardware, software, and infrastructure, ensuring value for money and fitness for purpose
Oversee the security and integrity of all ICT systems, including risk assessments, data protection compliance, and incident response planning
Set priorities and allocate resources across system development, maintenance, and daily operations to ensure continuity of service
Lead and manage the ICT team, including recruitment, performance management, professional development, and workload planning
Direct the provision of user training and technical support, ensuring staff are equipped to use systems effectively
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, including negotiating contracts, monitoring service levels, and ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes
Develop and manage ICT budgets, tracking expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising performance
Oversee the implementation of new systems and technology projects, managing timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication throughout
Ensure ICT operations comply with relevant legislation, industry standards, and internal governance frameworks
Produce and present regular reports on ICT performance, project progress, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Proven experience in an ICT management or senior technical leadership role, typically five or more years
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement ICT strategies, policies, and operational frameworks
Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity principles, and cloud-based technologies
Experience managing budgets, vendor contracts, and procurement processes within an ICT context
Solid understanding of data privacy legislation and information security standards, including ISO 27001 or equivalent
Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to mentor and develop technical teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a structured approach to decision-making
Effective communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience delivering ICT projects using recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2 or Agile
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification in IT management, business administration, or a related field
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, or equivalent
Experience working within regulated industries or government environments
Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) or customer relationship management (CRM) platforms
Knowledge of COBIT or other IT governance frameworks
Experience leading digital transformation or large-scale systems migration projects
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values technology as a driver of business success
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications and leadership programmes
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation and performance-based incentives
Contribute to meaningful projects that have a real impact on organisational outcomes and service delivery
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Sheet Metal Worker
Employer Sponsorship Available | Perth, WA | Full-Time
MYAC Resources is currently seeking experienced Sheet Metal Workers to join our growing network of leading Australian employers across Perth, Western Australia.
We have multiple long-term opportunities available for skilled tradespeople who take pride in producing high-quality workmanship and want to build a secure, rewarding career with established Australian businesses. Whether you're already in Australia or looking to relocate from overseas, employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates. If you're motivated, reliable and passionate about fabrication, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Role
As a Sheet Metal Worker, you'll play a key role in the fabrication, assembly and repair of precision sheet metal components used across a variety of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.
Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you'll be part of a professional team delivering quality workmanship while maintaining the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Fabricating and assembling sheet metal components to specification 
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings, technical plans and fabrication details 
• Cutting, folding, bending, rolling and shaping sheet metal 
• MIG and TIG welding where required 
• Operating fabrication equipment including press brakes, guillotines, rollers, punches and other workshop machinery 
• Measuring, marking and preparing materials for fabrication 
• Repairing, modifying and installing fabricated components 
• Conducting quality inspections to ensure finished products meet engineering specifications Maintaining workshop equipment and ensuring a clean, organised work environment 
• Working safely in accordance with all workplace health and safety procedures 

About You
To be successful in this role, you'll have:
• Trade qualification as a Sheet Metal Worker, Metal Fabricator or equivalent recognised trade qualification
• Previous experience in sheet metal fabrication

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and qualified Panel Beater to join either our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team to undertake quality workmanship to ensure vehicles are returned to their pre-accident condition.
